title: Inyenyeri Cumi n'Imwe Zarapfukamye
intro: Umuntu wo muri Korowani yahawe iyerekwa rikomeye akiri umwana - inzozi z'ibinyabutabire byo mu kirere bikubita hasi mu cyubahiro. Imyaka yashiraga mu guhemukirwa, gutandukana, gushinjwa ibinyoma no gufungwa mbere y'uko iri yerekwa riba impamo. Ni nde uyu muntu uhamye ufite inkuru irambuye mu gice kirekire cya Korowani?
clues: Nari nkiri muto, mfite inzozi zitangaje ndetse na data yamburiye ngo nzigire ibanga.
Bene data, bahumwe n'ishyari, bangiriye inama yo kungirira nabi banjugunya mu iriba ryijimye kandi rinini.
Najyanywe mu gihugu cya kure maze ndagurishwa mu rugo rw'umutware w'icyubahiro, aho nagiriwe ubuntu maze mpaguruka mu nshingano.
Gushinjwa ibinyoma byatumye mfungwa mu buryo bunyuranyije n'amategeko, nyamara muri ako gace k'umwijima nabonye ihumure mu gusenga no kunamira Imana.
Allah yampaye umugisha wo gusobanura inzozi mu buryo budasanzwe, amaherezo byanjyanye imbere y'umutegetsi w'igihugu kandi binshyira mu mwanya wo hejuru w'icyizere.
Nyuma y'imyaka myinshi yo gutandukana, nongeye guhura n'umuryango wanjye nkunda, kandi inzozi zanjye zo mu bwana z'inyenyeri cumi n'imwe, izuba n'ukwezi birambaramira zarasohoye.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
